text:
elaine: quick check — can we confirm the streaming delta for chat/completions still includes eventType and delta.payload when tool calls are emitted? I'm seeing a mismatch in the client shim tests.

sam: yeah noticed that too. client expects {eventType: 'tool_call', delta: {payload: ...}} but runtime is emitting {event: 'tool_call', data: ...} in the canary.

mike: iirc we decided on eventType to stay stable for backward compat. runtime change slipped through on the gateway transform.

elaine: important because our SDK's reassembly logic depends on delta.payload being present for mid-stream tool params. failing tests for resume.

jen: tagging eng-runtime and infra — @mike any chance you can point to the PR that caused this? will need a quick rollback or adapter. :eyes:

mike: PR is github.com/redwood/run/commit/ab12cd3 — changed field names to align with new internal telemetry. i can revert the transform in the gateway tonight.

elaine: if we revert, we should also add a lint rule for streaming shape. Maybe a small JSON schema check in the gateway that asserts eventType/delta.* for tool events.

sam: 👍 agree. also flag: the tool params envelope now includes base64 for binary chunks. clients expect plain JSON for tool.params when content-type is application/json. we need to not base64-encode there.

mike: good catch. that was a generic change; i'll limit it to attachments only. will open a PR for both revert + gate schema.

jen: for deployment — can we canary the revert to us-west-2 only? rollout-bot: deploy started for run-gateway -> canary(us-west-2) by mike @ 1767005400

elaine: when the canary is up, i'll run the SDK smoke (convo resume, funccall midstream) and post results here.

sam: if smoke passes, we should push the lint/validation rule in the same release. prevents reintroducing.

mike: PR 4921 opened: Revert streaming event rename + restrict base64. includes gateway JSON schema check and unit tests. linking: github.com/redwood/run/pull/4921

elaine: thanks. post-smoke i'll ping QA and leave the SDK short-circuit in place for one week as extra protection.

jen: note for release notes: call out "streaming: ensure tool_call eventType + delta.payload stability; disallow base64 in JSON tool.params" — add to changelog.

rollout-bot: canary deploy finished for run-gateway -> canary(us-west-2) status: success at 1767005588

elaine: smoke results: convo resume ✅, funccall midstream reassembly ✅, no client errors. looks good from SDK side.

sam: great. schedule full rollout at 00:30 UTC?jen: fine with me. mike: I'll coordinate the rollout and watch traces for any delta mismatch spans.

elaine: one follow-up task: create a tiny eval that asserts toolcall semantics across streaming and non-streaming endpoints so contract changes are caught in CI. added to my backlog.

sam: thanks everyone. :shipit:
